semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides specialized components and manufacturing services that are relevant to semiconductor equipment but does not directly engage in semiconductor fabrication or design.
summary: SUNJUSHI specializes in the manufacturing of precision components for semiconductor equipment, focusing on high dimensional accuracy and surface finish in plastic materials. They offer services such as cutting, turning, and welding of materials like PVC and PEEK, contributing to cost-effective solutions in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Precision machining of plastic components with H7 tolerance and Ra0.4 surface roughness
Welding services for PVC, PP, and PVDF materials
Manufacturing of cleaning valve components for semiconductor equipment
Production of stepped pin dummy parts and test socket dummy parts
